sents.en: No, I'm not. I'm a student.

sents.zh: 我不是中国人，我是美国人。
sents.spokenZh: 我不是中国人，我是美国人。

sents.zh: 她是我的汉语老师，她叫李月。
sents.en: She is my Chinese teacher. Her name is Li Yue.
sents.spokenZh: 她是我的汉语老师，她叫李月。

sents.en: What about her? Is she your classmate?

sents.zh: 她不是我同学，她是我朋友。
sents.en: No, she isn't. She is my friend.
sents.spokenZh: 她不是我同学，她是我朋友。

sents.en: How many people are there in your family?
How do you write this character?

sents.zh: 对不起，这个字我会读，不会写。
sents.en: Sorry. I can read it, but I don't know how to write it.
sents.spokenZh: 对不起，这个字我会读，不会写。

sents.en: Excuse me, what's the date today?

sents.zh: 昨天是八月三十一号，星期二。
sents.spokenZh: 昨天是八月三十一号，星期二。

sents.zh: 明天是九月二号，星期四。
sents.spokenZh: 明天是九月二号，星期四。

sents.zh: 明天星期六，你去学校吗？
sents.en: Tomorrow is Saturday. Will you go to school?
sents.spokenZh: 明天星期六，你去学校吗？

sents.en: What are you going to do there?
I'm going there to do some reading.
What would you like to drink?
What would you like to eat?
What would you like to do this afternoon?
What do you want to buy?
I want to buy a cup.
Hello! How much is this cup?
The puppy is under the chair.

sents.zh: 我儿子在医院工作，他是医生。
sents.en: My son works in a hospital. He is a doctor.
sents.spokenZh: 我儿子在医院工作，他是医生。

sents.en: What are there on the desk?

sents.zh: 桌子上有一个电脑和一本书。
sents.en: There is a computer and a book.
sents.spokenZh: 桌子上有一个电脑和一本书。

sents.zh: 前面那个人叫什么名字？
sents.en: Who is the person in the front?
sents.spokenZh: 前面那个人叫什么名字？

sents.en: She is Wang Fang. She works in a hospital.

sents.zh: 后面那个人呢？他叫什么名字？
sents.en: What about the person at the back? What's his name?
sents.spokenZh: 后面那个人呢？他叫什么名字？

sents.en: He is Xie Peng. He works in a store.
When shall we have our lunch?
At five o'clock in the afternoon.

sents.zh: 我们什么时候去看电影？
sents.en: When are we going to see the movie?
sents.spokenZh: 我们什么时候去看电影？

sents.en: I'll go to Beijing next Monday.
How long will you stay in Beijing?
Can you come back before Friday?

sents.zh: 昨天北京的天气怎么样？
sents.en: How was the weather in Beijing yesterday?
sents.spokenZh: 昨天北京的天气怎么样？

sents.zh: 明天呢？明天天气怎么样？
sents.en: What about tomorrow? What will the weather be like tomorrow?
sents.spokenZh: 明天呢？明天天气怎么样？

sents.zh: 明天天气很好，不冷不热。
sents.en: It will be fine, neither cold nor hot.
sents.spokenZh: 明天天气很好，不冷不热。

sents.en: No, she won't. It's too cold.

sents.zh: 我身体不太好。天气太热了，不爱吃饭。
sents.en: Not very well. It's too hot. I have no appetite.
sents.spokenZh: 我身体不太好。天气太热了，不爱吃饭。

sents.en: Eat more fruit and drink more water.

sents.zh: 他没看书，他在学做中国菜呢。
sents.en: No, he isn't. He is learning to cook Chinese food.
sents.spokenZh: 他没看书，他在学做中国菜呢。

sents.zh: 昨天上午你在做什么呢？
sents.en: What were you doing yesterday morning?
sents.spokenZh: 昨天上午你在做什么呢？

sents.en: I was sleeping. What about you?

sents.zh: 我在家看电视呢。你喜欢看电视吗？
sents.en: I was watching TV at home. Do you like watching TV?
sents.spokenZh: 我在家看电视呢。你喜欢看电视吗？

sents.zh: 我不喜欢看电视，我喜欢看电影。
sents.en: No, I don't. I like seeing movies.
sents.spokenZh: 我不喜欢看电视，我喜欢看电影。

sents.zh: 八二三零四一五五，这是李老师的电话吗？
sents.en: 82304155. Is that Ms. Li's telephone number?
sents.spokenZh: 八二三零四一五五，这是李老师的电话吗？

sents.zh: 不是。她的电话是八二三零四一五六。
sents.spokenZh: 不是。她的电话是八二三零四一五六。

sents.en: OK. I'll call her right now.

sents.zh: 她在工作呢，你下午打吧。
sents.en: She is working. Call her in the afternoon.
sents.spokenZh: 她在工作呢，你下午打吧。

sents.en: Where did you go yesterday morning?
Yes. He has gone to a driving lesson.
Wang Fang's dress is so pretty!
Yes. She has bought quite a few clothes.

sents.zh: 我没买，这些都是王方的东西。
sents.en: I bought nothing. All these are Wang Fang's stuff.
sents.spokenZh: 我没买，这些都是王方的东西。

sents.zh: 你和李小姐是什么时候认识的？
sents.en: When did you and Miss Li first meet?
sents.spokenZh: 你和李小姐是什么时候认识的？

sents.zh: 我们是二零一一年九月认识的。
sents.spokenZh: 我们是二零一一年九月认识的。

sents.en: Where did you meet each other?

sents.zh: 我们是在学校认识的，她是我大学同学。
sents.en: We met in our university. She was my classmate.
sents.spokenZh: 我们是在学校认识的，她是我大学同学。

sents.zh: 他是和朋友一起开车来的。
sents.en: He drove here with his friend.
sents.spokenZh: 他是和朋友一起开车来的。

sents.en: Nice to meet you, Miss Li.

sents.zh: 听张先生说，您是坐飞机来北京的？
sents.en: Mr. Zhang said you came to Beijing by plane, didn't you?
sents.spokenZh: 听张先生说，您是坐飞机来北京的？
